mapper.sql: SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.BOARD_ID, i.GROUP_ID, i.CATEGORY_ID, i.CONTENT AS TITLE, i.CONTENT, i.DESCRIPTION, i.STATUS, i.PRIORITY, i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, i.REQUEST_DATE, i.DUE_DATE, i.PREVIOUS_STATUS, i.COMPLETED_BY, i.DELETED_AT, i.DELETED_BY, i.TRANSFERRED_FROM, i.TRANSFERRED_AT, i.SORT_ORDER, i.CREATED_AT, i.CREATED_BY, i.UPDATED_AT, i.UPDATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, g.GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR, cat.CATEGORY_NAME, cat.CATEGORY_COLOR, ua.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, uc.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, uu.NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT c WHERE c.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID) AS COMMENT_COUNT, /* 이관 정보 - 원본 보드의 소유자가 이관자 */ tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USERNAME, ut.NAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USER_NAME, /* 공유 정보 - 기본값 NULL (공유 업무 조회 시 별도 설정) */ NULL AS IS_SHARED_TO_ME, NULL AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME, NULL AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON i.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY cat ON i.CATEGORY_ID = cat.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ua ON i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = ua.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uc ON i.CREATED_BY = uc.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uu ON i.UPDATED_BY = uu.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_BOARD tb_orig ON i.TRANSFERRED_FROM = tb_orig.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ut ON tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME = ut.USERNAME
mapper.select: WHERE i.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND ( (i.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(i.UPDATED_AT) = CURDATE()) OR (i.STATUS = 'DELETED' AND DATE(i.DELETED_AT) = CURDATE()) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN i.UPDATED_AT ELSE i.DELETED_AT END DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_ORDER), -1) FROM TB_ITEM WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITEM ( BOARD_ID, GROUP_ID, CATEGORY_ID, CONTENT, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, PRIORITY, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, REQUEST_DATE, DUE_DATE, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{groupId}, #{categoryId}, COALESCE(#{content}, #{title}), #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'NOT_STARTED'), COALESCE(#{priority}, 'NORMAL'), #{assigneeUsername}, #{requestDate}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET GROUP_ID = #{groupId}, CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, CONTENT = COALESCE(#{content}, #{title}), DESCRIPTION = #{description}, STATUS = #{status}, PRIORITY = #{priority}, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = #{assigneeUsername}, REQUEST_DATE = #{requestDate}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'COMPLETED', COMPLETED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'DELETED', DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET STATUS = COALESCE(PREVIOUS_STATUS, 'NOT_STARTED'), PREVIOUS_STATUS = NULL, DELETED_AT = NULL, DELETED_BY = NULL, COMPLETED_BY = NULL, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID WHERE i.DUE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND i.DUE_DATE < CURDATE() AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID WHERE i.STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET BOARD_ID = #{newBoardId}, TRANSFERRED_FROM = #{originalBoardId}, TRANSFERRED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET BOARD_ID = #{newBoardId}, TRANSFERRED_FROM = #{originalBoardId}, TRANSFERRED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID IN
#{itemId}
